headline_marked: Fire at [[Chawkbazar's Hazi Abul Bashar Super Market]] brought under control
headline: Fire at Chawkbazar's Hazi Abul Bashar Super Market brought under control
summary: The blaze broke out on the third floor of the eight-storey building this afternoon; no casualties have been reported.
details: A fire broke out at the Hazi Abul Bashar Super Market in the Chawkbazar area of Dhaka this afternoon.
According to a press release from the Fire Service and Civil Defence, the blaze originated on the third floor of the eight-storey building.
Firefighting units arrived at the scene at 1:46 pm and began working to extinguish the flames.
The fire was successfully brought under control and put out by approximately 3:15 pm.
There is currently no immediate information regarding the cause of the fire or any casualties.

headline_marked: At least 2,000 killed in July uprising: [[Govt committed to justice for every killing]]
headline: At least 2,000 killed in July uprising: Govt committed to justice for every killing
summary: Law Minister Md. Asaduzzaman affirms the government's resolve to implement the July Charter and ensure accountability for all deaths during the uprising.
details: Law Minister Md. Asaduzzaman stated that the government is determined to ensure justice for every single killing that occurred during the July uprising. He spoke at the July National Conference held on Saturday at the China-Bangladesh Friendship Convention Center in Dhaka.

The Minister emphasized that the government is committed to following every article of the July Charter to the letter. He warned against attempts to mislead the public through calls for referendums that are not part of the charter.
Asaduzzaman cautioned the public to remain vigilant against 'fascism' attempting to undermine sovereignty and 'fundamentalists' blinded by the desire for power.

He described the nation as currently divided into two groups: those who are attempting to profit from the July movement and those who are working steadily to implement the July Charter under the leadership of Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.
The event also served as a memorial for the victims of the uprising, with families of the deceased sharing their grief and the Prime Minister attending the conference to honor the martyrs.
caption:
At least 2,000 people were killed in the July uprising. The government now vows justice for every single one of them.

Law Minister Md. Asaduzzaman stated that the government is determined to ensure justice for every single killing that occurred during the July uprising. He spoke at the July National Conference held on Saturday at the China-Bangladesh Friendship Convention Center in Dhaka.

The Minister emphasized that the government is committed to following every article of the July Charter to the letter. He warned against attempts to mislead the public through calls for referendums that are not part of the charter.

Asaduzzaman cautioned the public to remain vigilant against 'fascism' attempting to undermine sovereignty and 'fundamentalists' blinded by the desire for power.

He described the nation as currently divided into two groups: those who are attempting to profit from the July movement and those who are working steadily to implement the July Charter under the leadership of Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.

The event also served as a memorial for the victims of the uprising, with families of the deceased sharing their grief and the Prime Minister attending the conference to honor the martyrs.

#Bangladesh #JulyUprising #Justice #Dhaka #Politics #HumanRights

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star, Somoy News
